input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides automatic successive one-year renewals but requires ninety (90) days' written notice to stop a renewal. That is a 90-day non-renewal notice window, which fails the fallback ceiling of 60 days (it is at, not beyond, the walk-away threshold). The renewal term itself is one year, which satisfies the 12-month element, and the fee is a fixed 30% revenue share in Section 3.1 with no renewal price-uplift mechanic anywhere in the Agreement, so the conditional price-increase cap is not engaged. We therefore made the single minimal fallback edit: the Company's notice window drops to sixty (60) days, while HDI's ninety-day window is left intact so we do not hand HDI an easier exit. Preferred features (30-day opt-out and a 60-day vendor reminder) are noted but not pressed.

proposal.summary: Shorten the Company's non-renewal/termination notice window from 90 to 60 days, leaving HDI's window unchanged
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position caps the non-renewal notice window at 60 days, so we shortened the Company's notice to sixty days while leaving HDI's ninety-day window untouched. The one-year renewal term and the absence of any renewal price uplift are already acceptable.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
ops.newText: unless terminated by the Company upon sixty (60), or by HDI upon ninety (90), days written notice to the other.
